messages:
Maya Chen: Hey — ran into a funky case in the browser SDK today. User clicked browser Back during a streaming response and we started seeing JSON.parse errors in app code. Error looks like: 
```
Unexpected end of JSON input
at parse (app.js:45)
```
Feels like the stream was cut in the middle of a token and we forwarded partial chunk to JSON.parse.

Jonah Patel: ugh. can you repro locally? is it the SDK or our sample app logic?

Maya Chen: repro is small. Steps: start streaming chat, immediately hit back (or trigger History.back()). Server closes; chrome gives partial chunk to ReadableStream. Browser TextDecoder gives a truncated UTF-8 sequence -> when we concat and parse we get syntax error. Happens only in browser, not node.

Samir Bhandari: this rings a bell — multi-byte UTF-8 chars + splitting across chunk boundary will break naive decoder handling. Are we using incremental TextDecoder with {stream: true}?

Maya Chen: nope, our sample app currently does `const decoder = new TextDecoder()` and `decoder.decode(chunk)` per chunk then push to buffer. That loses state for split multibyte sequences.

Ava Rodriguez: that's a nice find. SDK parity note: node SDK uses streaming decoder properly, but browser example app doesn't. We should update the browser sample and the JS SDK to use `const decoder = new TextDecoder(); decoder.decode(chunk, {stream: true})` and only call `decoder.decode()` (no stream) at end. Also need to ensure we only call JSON.parse when we've seen a full record delimiter (e.g. `

` or event boundaries).

Jonah Patel: also saw an auth-refresh race last week: token refresh triggered while a long-lived stream was open, and the auth proxy returned a 401 mid-stream which the runtime closes with an HTML error chunk. The client tried to parse that as SSE and exploded. We should surface a `stream-auth` event or at least provide a clear error with status code.

Maya Chen: exact stack: stream delivered partial JSON, then we got an HTML page chunk `<!doctype html>...401...` which our parser appended and parse failed. Chrome doesn't throw distinct error for mid-stream 401 vs server-initiated close.

Samir Bhandari: Proposed SDK changes: 
- In browser SDK: use TextDecoder streaming API and maintain a `leftover` buffer for partial multibyte sequences. 
- Parse by delimiting on `

` (SSE event boundary) and only JSON.parse complete events. 
- If connection is closed mid-event, emit `incomplete` event rather than attempting parse; include raw bytes for debugging. 
- Expose a `status` + `headers` when the stream ends with non-200 so apps can distinguish auth errors.

Ava Rodriguez: docs/onboarding: add a short note about handling Back/Abort/Navigation for single-page apps and add sample snippet for `window.onpopstate` to gracefully cancel stream. Also add a small test in `devex/sample-apps/streaming` that reproduces multi-byte-split case.

Maya Chen: Repro code for browser fetch streaming I used: 
```js
const res = await fetch('/v1/stream', {signal});
const reader = res.body.getReader();
const decoder = new TextDecoder(); // <-- change to streaming
let buffer = '';
while(true){
  const {done, value} = await reader.read();
  if(done) break;
  buffer += decoder.decode(value); // problematic on multibyte splits
  // naive parse here -> break
}
```

Jonah Patel: For retry behavior: we shouldn't auto-retry a streaming request if any non-empty response body was already delivered to app. That can lead to duplicated side effects. If we want resume, implement resume tokens and explicit resume API. SDK should expose a policy: `autoRetryStreaming: 'none'|'resume'` and default to 'none'.

Samir Bhandari: Agree. And add `last_event_id`/resume token support in the protocol + sample flow in SDK. We can implement short resume window server-side (e.g., 30s) for clients that reconnect quickly.

Ava Rodriguez: Action items: 
- Maya: open a tiny PR to update sample app to use streaming TextDecoder + delimiting (ETA: today) 
- Samir: spec a small API change for browser SDK to surface status/headers on stream end and add `streamError` event (ETA: end of week) 
- Jonah: add integration test proving back-button abort + multibyte char split (ETA: this sprint) 
- Devex-bot: create ticket and link PRs.

devex-bot: Created ticket INF-2043 "browser-sdk: handle split UTF-8/chunk-boundary + auth-mid-stream" and added assignees Maya, Samir, Jonah. :thumbsup: 

Maya Chen: Thanks — I'll attach a tiny log capture and a recording. If anyone hits this before our fixes, workaround is to 1) use TextDecoder with {stream:true} and 2) buffer until a clear record delimiter before parsing.

Jonah Patel: also add a one-liner in the SDK changelog about not auto-retrying streaming requests. Saves future confusion. :+1: 

Samir Bhandari: cool. I'll add unit tests for partial utf8 sequences and HTML error injection mid-stream.

Ava Rodriguez: great sync. moving to implement docs PR after Samir's SDK spec.

Maya Chen: closing loop — will drop a tiny gist in the ticket with the repro code and logs. Thanks all! :tada:
